nar.text: The 1:30 p.m. start was not carried out with the usual flag but by an optical signal. It was raining.

The mechanics push Lang towards Eau Rouge as Hasse goes by; the Mercedes fires at the last moment and Lang chases Hasse down.
Lang was able to not only get passed the Auto Union but at the finish was 17 seconds ahead to a cheerless victory.
Von Brauchitsch came third, almost two minutes behind his winning teammate, followed by the Sommer, Mazaud, Gerard, three, five, and six laps back respectively.
